description: Experience contract for Infrastructure Manager, the infra-health team's instrument. The UI is deliberately the last surface to be built (OT-P2-001) — the programmatic CLI and Connect surfaces come first — so these specs are authored ahead of implementation to fix the honesty obligations before pixels harden around them. Every page here inherits one rule: no number is shown without the qualifier that makes it honest, and no unreadable source is ever allowed to look healthy.
